ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels vs 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region originating from the peduncle, forming an irregular triangular shape that branches into high-frequency mottling and focal clusters along the medial transition zones and the trailing edge boundary. High-intensity white contiguous blocks occupy the majority of the left and right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; bounding-box depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical lobe extension.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge; medial regions show low-amplitude valleys (3-5 pixels) while distal tips exhibit high-amplitude jagged peaks (15-25 pixels) due to external colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a concave mathematical curve tapering to acute points; trailing edges follow a sigmoidal curve transitioning from convex at the mid-point to concave at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, textured circular clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, representing barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the mid-medial region of the left lobe and smaller horizontal disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the left and right lobe tips; scattered minor rake marks visible across the high-intensity pigmentation areas.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, distinct low-intensity circular focal spot located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe, isolated from other mottling.
